informal_statement: Scaling an enclosing rational interval by a nonnegative rational q encloses the real product qx, including q = 0 and q = 1/2.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At ScalarSuffixCertificate.lean:98-108, the source contract is `theorem realContains_nsmul {i : QInterval} {x : ℝ} {q : ℚ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hx : i.RealContains x) : (i.nsmul q hq).RealContains ((q : ℝ) * x)`. The enclosure theorem applies to every nonnegative rational scaling factor, including zero and fractions, and transports the interval endpoints through the rational-to-real cast. This matches the deliberately broader meaning of nsmul used in the author's explanation.
